answer.evidence: The tree is an oval canopy (rows 1-33) on a narrow trunk (rows 34-47, width 6 widening to 12 at the roots). The canopy silhouette is a smooth egg shape with leaf-clump highlights scattered through it. There is no front-edge line, no eave shadow and no ellipse top plane. The canopy reads as a rounded front-facing mass, and the trunk is a vertical face with no top. No horizontal top surface is evident, so it reads as front elevation.

By eye the canopy is a smooth, symmetric oval with only about 4 greens (dark rim, mid, light patches) and scattered red apple dots. It has no irregular leaf-clump silhouette, no per-clump highlights and no shadowed underside. The trunk is a plain two-tone block with no roots or branches reaching into the canopy. The tone count alone does not make up for the shallower ramp and the lack of clump structure.
